mentions.name: Pulto
mentions.description: A Jupyter notebook client for visionOS that visualizes 3D data, currently supporting point clouds, USDZ models, and Gaussian Splats. It is being prepared for launch on the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a Jupyter notebook client for VisionOS. It allows for 3D data to be visualized on visionOS. Right now it supports point cloud data, USDZ models and Gaussian Splats.
mentions.author: zitterbewegung
